reconstruction.source_state: Candidate for native and source-camera validation; runtime validation is a separate gate.
reconstruction.rebuild: Load this JSON as PitRoute and encode_route for pit_lane.bin. Compose protection with circuit escapes through circuit_route_assets.py; do not overwrite a combined protection file with the standalone pit-only encoding.

recipe_snapshot.source_note: Literal mapped OSM pit path with primaryGoogle andFIAcorroboration. Legacyframe sourcefit RMS~1–2m, maximum~7m atInterlagos, explicitphase+58m. Nativewholeloop/roadunchanged. Nominal6m drivablecorridor is estimated within sourcepavement, not surveyed fast-lane width. Endpointsregistered within retainedfituncertainty; native source/cooked gatesrequired. Old retained off-road driving surface has up to55% transverse natural-terrain slope along this newlyopenedrealpitpath. The new longitudinalpitgrade is reconstructed from adjacent unchangedRoadheight/edgelevel, withtransversegrade interpolatedbetweenknownentry/exitRoadcrossfalls. Sourceheights/crossfall are estimates, notsurvey. Physicalsupport/oldterraincut/garageapron/bodycamera reviewrequired.

plan_registration.imagery_epoch: Unknown; provider acquisition and watermark do not establish capture year.

floor_transition_snapshot.source_note: Finite estimated entry/exit ramp between retained source-derived level controls. XY and both outside height fields unchanged. This interpolation resolves a pointwise projection/old-paving join; it is not a surveyed pit section. Source/native apron and contact review required.

protection_snapshot.source_note: Retained barrier geometry plus primary Google pit/road/garage relationship. New divider lies between unchanged Road+0.85m kerb and actual mapped pit paving; XY is estimated within this visible strip. Existing 0.95m concrete collision height and 0.15m radius retained. Native/source review required, especially joins to retained wall ends.

reconstruction.validation_limits: Sampled runtime PASS does not establish full driving, native mesh clearance, geometry fidelity or visual approval. Reconstructed ramp heights and divider positions retain their stated uncertainty.

legacy_registration.native_anchor_convention: Literal relation start is anchored exactly to the unchanged native road. Interlagos retains the fitted scale/rotation; its anchor differs by about 1m from the unconstrained least-squares intercept.

reconstruction.floor_rule: Adjacent unchanged road edge heights and known entry/exit crossfalls define an estimated paved pit grade. Old off-road terrain reaches55% crossfall and is not treated as a real pit surface. New terrain cuts and garage-floor agreement require native review.
